meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能通过Figma REST API分析你提供的Figma文件链接，提取页面、屏幕、组件、组件集、实例及设计令牌，生成交互式设计知识图谱和仪表盘。
howto.when: 当你提供Figma文件URL或文件密钥（key），或要求分析Figma设计时触发。

say.text: 查看这个Figma设计的组件结构
say.note: 生成包含所有页面和组件的知识图谱

say.text: 帮我理解这个Figma设计中的设计令牌
say.note: 提取颜色、字体等设计系统信息

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API, extract pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, and design tokens, then generate an interactive design knowledge graph and dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a Figma file URL or key, or ask to analyze a Figma design.

say_en.note: Claude will fetch and parse the Figma file

say_en.text: Show me the component structure of this Figma design
say_en.note: Generates a knowledge graph with all pages and components

say_en.text: Help me understand the design tokens in this Figma
say_en.note: Extracts color, typography, etc., design system info
